title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: From an Epistle of the Same to the Blessed Amphilochius on the Difference of Meats

verses.text:
From an Epistle of the Same to
the Blessed Amphilochius on the Difference of Meats.

(Found translated in lib. cit., p. 287,
part of Epistle ccxxxvj.)

Against the Encratites, who would not eat
flesh.
